column1: # What a developer gets from every route: the reviewed statement of the
# role. It differs from the viewer's matrix in exactly twelve routes
# (deploy, cutover, rollback, manual deploy record, alert rule and
# issue rule create and delete, mark one and mark all notifications
# read, env stage and env remove-entry), and a test holds it to that.
# Reaching the two env routes is not the whole story: past the guard a
# developer is a proposer, refused every secret key by the handler. A new route adds one line here,
# Columns: route, a developer with all services, a developer granted
# one service calling it for that service, the same developer calling
# it for a service outside the grant. "reach" means the request got
# past the guard to the handler; a number is the status the guard
# answered. Without service_id, POST /api/notifications/read is reached
# by a scoped developer and marks only the granted services.
